segments.text: Hello and welcome to this massive open online course introduction to virus management.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎学习这门大规模开放在线课程“生物风险管理导论”。

segments.text: I am your instructor Kenneth and in this module we will be focusing on the management of clinical samples.
segments.zh: 我是你们的讲师 Kenneth，在本模块中，我们将重点讨论临床样本的管理。

segments.text: Clinical samples are samples derived from hospital patients and these are analyzed routinely in hospital laboratories
segments.zh: 临床样本是取自医院患者的样本，通常在医院实验室

segments.text: or in specifically designated pathological laboratories.
segments.zh: 或专门指定的病理实验室中进行分析。

segments.text: The objectives of this module are to introduce you to the different types of clinical samples,
segments.zh: 本模块的目标是向大家介绍不同类型的临床样本，

segments.text: to understand the various processes involved in analyzing clinical samples,
segments.zh: 了解分析临床样本所涉及的各种流程，

segments.text: to assess the risks posed during the processing of clinical samples,
segments.zh: 评估处理临床样本过程中存在的风险，

segments.text: to identify pertinent controls for the mitigation of the risks
segments.zh: 确定用于缓解这些风险的相应控制措施，

segments.text: and to understand the implications for biosecurity management of clinical samples.
segments.zh: 并了解临床样本生物安保管理的相关要求。

segments.text: The learning outcomes for this module are as follows.
segments.zh: 本模块的学习成果如下。

segments.text: Upon completion of this module you should be able to describe the various types of clinical samples,
segments.zh: 完成本模块后，你应该能够描述临床样本的各种类型，

segments.text: describe the process involved in the diagnosis of microbial, serological and nucleic acid samples,
segments.zh: 描述微生物样本、血清学样本和核酸样本的诊断流程，

segments.text: apply the pertinent controls to mitigate the risks posed by processing of clinical samples
segments.zh: 运用相应的控制措施来缓解处理临床样本带来的风险，

segments.text: and describe the management of the security aspects of sample analysis.
segments.zh: 并描述样本分析中安保方面的管理。

segments.text: Clinical samples can present themselves in many ways.
segments.zh: 临床样本有多种形式。

segments.text: They can be in the form of blood, serum, swabs, stool, urine, body fluids or biopsies.
segments.zh: 可以是血液、血清、拭子、粪便、尿液、体液或活检组织。

segments.text: Risk assessment for clinical samples has to take the following facts into consideration.
segments.zh: 临床样本的风险评估必须考虑以下几个事实。

segments.text: The first fact is that the clinical sample consists of multiple biological agents derived from a single patient.
segments.zh: 第一个事实是，临床样本中含有来自同一名患者的多种生物因子。

segments.text: In this case, the risk group will be unknown.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，风险等级组是未知的。

segments.text: And it is advisable to assume the highest risk group.
segments.zh: 因此建议按照最高风险等级组来对待。

segments.text: One of the ways in which you can obtain information about the sample is by referring to the sample collection sheet.
segments.zh: 获取样本信息的方法之一，是查阅样本采集单。

segments.text: This will offer an insight into the case history of the patient as well as his or her current status.
segments.zh: 它能让你了解患者的病史以及他或她目前的状况。

segments.text: Take note that some of the patients may be asymptomatic carriers and may not manifest any of the clinical symptoms
segments.zh: 请注意，有些患者可能是无症状携带者，可能不会表现出

segments.text: which are associated with a specific biological agent.
segments.zh: 与某种特定生物因子相关的任何临床症状。

segments.text: In some cases, the sample may be transported or dissolved in a specific chemical or reagent.
segments.zh: 在某些情况下，样本可能保存在某种特定的化学品或试剂中运输，或溶解于其中。

segments.text: In this case, we must refer to the material safety data sheets which will accompany the samples.
segments.zh: 这时，我们必须查阅随样本附带的安全技术说明书。

segments.text: Sample processing.
segments.zh: 样本处理。

segments.text: There are four diagnostic procedures which can be associated with the processing of clinical isolates.
segments.zh: 临床分离物的处理可能涉及四种诊断程序。

segments.text: The first procedure may involve microbial isolation and culture.
segments.zh: 第一种程序可能涉及微生物的分离和培养。

segments.text: In this case, the laboratory technician will perform a serial dilution of the sample
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，实验室技术人员会对样本进行梯度稀释，

segments.text: and culture the biological agent on a selective medium or isolate DNA directly from the sample itself.
segments.zh: 并在选择性培养基上培养生物因子，或者直接从样本中提取 DNA。

segments.text: The second diagnostic procedure involves serological tests such as enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays
segments.zh: 第二种诊断程序涉及血清学检测，比如酶联免疫吸附试验，

segments.text: in order to determine the interaction between antigen and antibodies.
segments.zh: 用以确定抗原与抗体之间的相互作用。

segments.text: The third procedure may involve nucleic acid extraction and polymerase chain reaction
segments.zh: 第三种程序可能涉及核酸提取和聚合酶链式反应，

segments.text: in order to analyze viral DNA and RNA from patient samples.
segments.zh: 用以分析患者样本中的病毒 DNA 和 RNA。

segments.text: And the fourth procedure may involve microscopy of the sample.
segments.zh: 第四种程序可能涉及对样本进行显微镜检查。

segments.text: Risk mitigation is generally applied to mitigate or reduce the risk caused by the biological agent.
segments.zh: 风险缓解通常用于减轻或降低生物因子造成的风险。

segments.text: The first step in risk mitigation involves the transport chain.
segments.zh: 风险缓解的第一步涉及运输链。

segments.text: The sample will generally be transported from the hospital or collection center via the transport network.
segments.zh: 样本通常会通过运输网络从医院或采集中心运出。

segments.text: You must ensure that the sample is packaged appropriately.
segments.zh: 你必须确保样本包装得当。

segments.text: The sample is clearly labeled.
segments.zh: 样本要有清晰的标签。

segments.text: Absorbent material is included in the sample packaging to absorb any of the spills which may occur during transit.
segments.zh: 样本包装中要放入吸附材料，以吸收运输途中可能发生的任何泄漏。

segments.text: Adequate cooling agents such as dry ice or ice packs must be shipped with the sample in order to maintain its integrity.
segments.zh: 必须随样本一起寄运足量的冷却剂，比如干冰或冰袋，以保持样本的完整性。

segments.text: The usage of ice flakes is not recommended as this may be prone to contamination.
segments.zh: 不建议使用碎冰，因为碎冰容易造成污染。

segments.text: Personnel such as drivers and couriers must be trained in sample transport
segments.zh: 司机和快递员等人员必须接受样本运输方面的培训，

segments.text: and must be aware of the risk caused by the biological agent contained within the sample.
segments.zh: 并且必须了解样本中所含生物因子带来的风险。

segments.text: This is one of the symbols which are generally labeled onto samples.
segments.zh: 这是通常贴在样本上的标志之一。

segments.text: This is the symbol for biohazard.
segments.zh: 这是生物危害标志。

segments.text: Risk mitigation and sample documentation.
segments.zh: 风险缓解与样本记录。

segments.text: All samples must be documented upon receipt in both an electronic and handwritten format.
segments.zh: 所有样本在接收时都必须以电子和手写两种形式进行登记。

segments.text: Samples may be assigned specific codes in order to protect the identity of the patient.
segments.zh: 可以给样本分配特定的编码，以保护患者的身份。

segments.text: Documents associated with the sample must be stored in secure locations
segments.zh: 与样本相关的文件必须存放在安全的地方，

segments.text: or if it is electronic data, it must be stored on secure servers.
segments.zh: 如果是电子数据，则必须存储在安全的服务器上。

segments.text: Inventory management is essential in the event that the samples are archived.
segments.zh: 如果样本需要归档保存，库存管理就必不可少。

segments.text: Risk mitigation for sample culture.
segments.zh: 样本培养的风险缓解。

segments.text: Microbial samples derived from bacteria viruses may be cultured in appropriate media.
segments.zh: 来自细菌、病毒的微生物样本可以在适当的培养基中培养。

segments.text: Risk assessment must be conducted for exonic cultures based on the specific risk group.
segments.zh: 必须根据具体的风险等级组，对纯培养物进行风险评估。

segments.text: Some samples may have specific risks associated with them such as the ability to produce pores or be dispersed via aerosols.
segments.zh: 有些样本可能带有特定的风险，比如能够产生孢子或通过气溶胶扩散。

segments.text: The judicious use of controls is required in order to mitigate the risk posed by microbes.
segments.zh: 需要审慎地运用控制措施，以缓解微生物带来的风险。

segments.text: Risk mitigation for serological procedures.
segments.zh: 血清学程序的风险缓解。

segments.text: Serological procedures may involve the use of centrifugation for the recovery of serum.
segments.zh: 血清学程序可能需要使用离心来获取血清。

segments.text: This must be done within a biosafety level 2, DSL2, or a biosafety level 3 laboratory.
segments.zh: 这必须在生物安全二级（BSL2）或生物安全三级实验室中进行。

segments.text: Certain procedures such as samples derived from patients infected with risk group 4 pathogens
segments.zh: 某些程序，例如处理来自感染了风险等级 4 组病原体的患者的样本，

segments.text: may need to be done in a BSL4 facility in order to limit the risk of exposure of the laboratory workers
segments.zh: 可能需要在 BSL4 设施中进行，以限制实验室工作人员

segments.text: and the environment to the biological agent.
segments.zh: 和环境暴露于生物因子的风险。

segments.text: One of the key aspects of sample management involves the processing of waste after the sample has been analyzed.
segments.zh: 样本管理的关键环节之一，是样本分析完成后的废弃物处理。

segments.text: All laboratory waste derived from the process of clinical samples must be treated as hazardous.
segments.zh: 处理临床样本过程中产生的所有实验室废弃物都必须作为危险废物对待。

segments.text: Waste should be labeled appropriately and catalogued.
segments.zh: 废弃物应贴上适当的标签并编目登记。

segments.text: Waste must be autoclaved except for specific volatile or corrosive substances
segments.zh: 废弃物必须进行高压灭菌，但某些挥发性或腐蚀性物质除外，

segments.text: which may necessitate special decontamination procedures.
segments.zh: 它们可能需要采用专门的去污程序。

segments.text: Biological waste may also be incinerated after autoclaving.
segments.zh: 生物废弃物在高压灭菌后还可以进行焚烧。

segments.text: Generally, laboratories appoint a specialized company to manage biological waste after decontamination at the facility.
segments.zh: 一般来说，实验室会委托专业公司，管理在设施内去污后的生物废弃物。

segments.text: Performance assessment.
segments.zh: 绩效评估。

segments.text: Performance can be assessed at the facility by analysis of the incident and accident reports.
segments.zh: 可以通过分析事件和事故报告来评估设施的绩效。

segments.text: Baseline monitoring of serum of the laboratory personnel will also provide an indication of the degree of risk mitigation.
segments.zh: 对实验室人员的血清进行本底监测，也能反映风险缓解的程度。

segments.text: Procedural audits based on observation of the personnel by the biosafety officer or an independent auditor
segments.zh: 由生物安全官或独立审核员通过观察人员操作进行的程序审核，

segments.text: also provide the relevant assessment of performance.
segments.zh: 同样可以对绩效作出相应的评估。

segments.text: Reporting of incidents.
segments.zh: 事件报告。

segments.text: All incidents must be reported to the biosafety officer.
segments.zh: 所有事件都必须报告给生物安全官。

segments.text: Appropriate documentation of the incident in a specific form is necessary in order to ensure traceability.
segments.zh: 必须使用专门的表格对事件进行适当记录，以确保可追溯性。

segments.text: Identification of the root cause of the incident is essential in order to prevent recurrence of that particular incident.
segments.zh: 找出事件的根本原因，对于防止该事件再次发生至关重要。

segments.text: Revision of the standard operating procedure is required in order to prevent the same incident from recovering.
segments.zh: 需要修订标准操作规程，以防止同样的事件再次发生。

segments.text: Reporting of accidents.
segments.zh: 事故报告。

segments.text: Accidents pose a serious threat to personnel as well as the operation of the laboratory facility.
segments.zh: 事故会对人员以及实验室设施的运行构成严重威胁。

segments.text: All accidents must be reported to the laboratory management.
segments.zh: 所有事故都必须报告给实验室管理层。

segments.text: The management will be required to report an accident to the local authorities in order to facilitate investigation.
segments.zh: 管理层需要向地方当局报告事故，以便于开展调查。

segments.text: Identification of the causative factors and the controls which can be applied to mitigate the risk of accidents is essential in order to prevent recurrence of these accidents.
segments.zh: 找出致因因素以及可用于降低事故风险的控制措施，对于防止这些事故再次发生至关重要。

segments.text: Data security.
segments.zh: 数据安全。

segments.text: Clinical samples involve the management of patient data.
segments.zh: 临床样本涉及患者数据的管理。

segments.text: All data must be kept confidential.
segments.zh: 所有数据都必须保密。

segments.text: Employees must be required to sign a non-disclosure agreement.
segments.zh: 员工必须签署保密协议。

segments.text: Data must be secured electronically.
segments.zh: 数据必须以电子方式加以保护。

segments.text: All printed documents must be stored securely as controlled documents.
segments.zh: 所有打印的文件都必须作为受控文件妥善保管。

segments.text: Copies of documents or data must not be made prior to obtaining written authorization.
segments.zh: 在获得书面授权之前，不得复制文件或数据。

segments.text: Inventory management.
segments.zh: 库存管理。

segments.text: Patient samples must be stored for future detailed analysis.
segments.zh: 患者样本必须保存起来，以备将来进行详细分析。

segments.text: The samples must be stored under the appropriate conditions.
segments.zh: 样本必须在适当的条件下保存。

segments.text: Physical security must be maintained.
segments.zh: 必须保持实体安保。

segments.text: Inventory management is essential in order to ensure traceability of samples.
segments.zh: 库存管理对于确保样本的可追溯性至关重要。

segments.text: Compliance with specific standards.
segments.zh: 遵守特定标准。

segments.text: Your respective organization may be required to comply with specific national and local regulations.
segments.zh: 你所在的机构可能需要遵守特定的国家和地方法规。

segments.text: Please refer to these laws and regulations when developing your biosafety manual.
segments.zh: 在编写生物安全手册时，请参考这些法律法规。

segments.text: A general document for reference is the CWA 15793, also known as the SEND workshop agreement, on laboratory bioresk management.
segments.zh: 一份可供参考的通用文件是 CWA 15793，也称为关于实验室生物风险管理的 CEN 研讨会协议。

segments.text: I will be covering this in another tutorial on laboratory bioresk management.
segments.zh: 我会在另一个关于实验室生物风险管理的教程中讲解这部分内容。

segments.text: To summarize, this module was designed and developed to introduce you to the basic guidelines in the management of clinical samples.
segments.zh: 总之，本模块旨在向大家介绍临床样本管理的基本指南。

segments.text: You will have to develop specific procedures for bioresk management based on your organizational procedures and in compliance with local standards.
segments.zh: 你需要根据所在机构的规程，并遵守当地标准，制定具体的生物风险管理程序。

segments.text: Thank you very much for participating in this module.
segments.zh: 非常感谢大家参与本模块的学习。

segments.text: Stay biosale!
segments.zh: 请注意生物安全！
